questions.question: A player holds a loaned species-background card with a printed violet resource-paid upgrade converter. May the borrower run that converter in Trade, and is the alternative named-card upgrade route subject to the same ownership conditions or different ones?

required_facts.fact: The borrower may run the in-play loaned card’s violet resource-paid upgrade converter during Trade
Named-card route requires both cards in play with their own owner, not on loan; borrower cannot use it

contextual_background: Optional explanation, not a separate omission gate: Narrating payment of the printed resource inputs. Booklet p6 allows violet converters during Trade, separates the resource-paid route from the named-card ownership sentence.

questions.question: An agreed future delivery becomes impossible. May the player offer substitute compensation instead, whose agreement is required, and do fixed nonfulfillment penalties automatically apply if everyone involved agrees to and receives that compensation?

required_facts.fact: Substitute compensation may resolve impossible promise
Everyone involved, including wronged parties, must agree
Accepted and delivered compensation does not automatically add fixed nonfulfillment penalties

questions.question: During setup, where does each species get its starting resource quantities and ship count? Does setup first run all starting economic converters or collect the values printed on the species card, and which phase begins play?

required_facts.fact: Collect starting resources and number of ships printed on species card
No initial converter-running Economy; first phase is Trade

questions.question: For non-Yengii era I–III inventions being shared in Confluence, what must the inventor announce, where and on which face are the invented technology cards placed, and how are their names made identifiable?

required_facts.fact: Announce every technology being shared
Place invented technology cards face down in center
Splay so names are readable

questions.question: At the end of an ordinary turn, what happens to the current Confluence Technology Sharing Bonus card, what does its back show, and which phase begins when another ordinary turn remains?

required_facts.fact: Flip current Confluence card upside down and add to shared-technology splay
Its back lists remaining phases
Next ordinary turn starts with Trade

questions.question: After converting leftover resources and ships to final points, what do players reveal and how is the winner determined?

required_facts.fact: Reveal hidden victory points
Highest total victory points wins

questions.question: When a Zeth stealing converter permits taking an ordinary large cube, may that cube be black, blue or yellow regardless of color, and do the size and shape of the depicted stolen goods still limit the theft?

required_facts.fact: Ordinary stolen large cube may be black, blue or yellow; color ignored
Theft must still match permitted size and shape

questions.question: May Faderan trade its Acknowledgment tokens to other players during the Trade Phase?

required_facts.fact: Faderan may trade its Acknowledgment tokens to others during Trade

questions.question: For a cheaper Zeth stealing-input option conditional on envoy tokens, whose token holdings determine eligibility? If the intended target has no envoy tokens, do tokens still in Zeth’s stash alone unlock that envoy-conditioned discount?

required_facts.fact: Envoy-conditioned cheaper input depends on tokens held by intended theft target
Zeth stash alone does not qualify target with no envoy tokens

questions.question: On ordinary cards, in which phase may a white economic converter run and in which phase may a violet converter run? What does an outstretched-hand symbol with a violet outline on an output identify?

required_facts.fact: Ordinary white economic converters run in Economy
Violet converters run in Trade
Outstretched hand and violet output outline identify donation goods

contextual_background: Donation-area disposal is separately asked in Q07; final retention in Q10. The final scoring card arrows are formula reminders, not ordinary converters.

questions.question: May Zeth send the Envoys factory resources to a player alone, or must an envoy token accompany those resources to the same player when they are traded or gifted?

required_facts.fact: An envoy token must be sent along with all Envoys factory resources to the same player when traded or gifted

questions.question: May Zeth trade a spare envoy token from its stash to another player during Trade, as distinct from gifting that spare token?

required_facts.fact: Zeth may trade a spare stash envoy token to another player during Trade

contextual_background: Zeth may not gift a spare stash envoy token. This is correct context here; the gift prohibition is expressly asked in Q49, and is not a separate omission gate in this positive-trade question.

questions.question: Before dealing starting colonies and research teams, how are those two decks prepared, which era is used for research, which faces are up, and may the cards be inspected while preparing them?

required_facts.fact: Shuffle colony deck without inspecting cards, front side up
Shuffle era-I research cards without looking, research-team side up

questions.question: After Kjasjavikalimm elects to split its colony bid, when are the resulting halves resolved relative to other bids: are both purchases made at the original full-bid opportunity, or does each half get its own later opportunity at its resulting bid rank?

required_facts.fact: Each half resolves later at its own resulting bid rank, rather than both purchases at original full-bid opportunity

questions.question: After Faderan pays the ordinary relic-deck converter during Trade, which relic is put into play? May Faderan choose another card from that deck or keep the resulting relic out of play for later instead?

required_facts.fact: The top relic-deck card is the card put into play; no choosing another relic
That card enters play on resolving the converter during Trade, rather than being held out of play for later

contextual_background: Converter costs/activation limits and individual entry rewards are separately tested, not additional omission gates here.

questions.question: After colony bids have resolved but before research bids are revealed, may a player expose the ships in their retained, nonbidding pile, or must those ships remain hidden until both bid rounds finish?

required_facts.fact: The retained nonbidding ship pile stays hidden until both bid rounds are over; it may not be exposed between colony resolution and research reveal

contextual_background: Exposing the reserve could reveal the unrevealed research bid by subtraction from announced total; that explanation is not an omission gate.

questions.question: In standard final scoring, may incomplete resource groups be pooled by nominal value across categories or rounded together? If a player has one large cube and two small cubes, no ships or other resources, how many points do those leftovers add?

required_facts.fact: Do not pool incomplete categories by nominal value or round their fractional values together
The specified one large cube and two small cubes add zero points

contextual_background: The numerical rates and separate incomplete-group explanations may support the answer but are not independent omission criteria here.
